source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-40

procedures.title: Hard top vinyl covering: install
steps: Clean the roof panel with a Xylol solvent (e.g. 3M Adhesive Cleaner or equivalent); let the solvent soak before rubbing, and remove or smooth out leftover old cement.
If possible, fit the new cover at room temperature (about 72°) so it fits easier and wrinkles come out.
Find the roof panel center line by marking center points at the front of the hard top and at the back window opening.
Fold the cover lengthwise, lay it on the roof panel and set the overhang (about 1").
Apply nitrile non-staining vinyl trim adhesive (e.g. 3M Vinyl Trim Adhesive) to the roof panel beside the fabric cover center line.
Keep the cement coat as thin as possible, using a mohair roller.
notes: Too much cement can trap solvent and cause blisters between cover and roof panel.
If nitrile non-staining cement is unavailable, a neoprene non-staining weatherstrip cement (3M weatherstrip cement or equivalent) may be used.
Figure 69 in the manual shows marking a molding position with a pencil; figure 70 (Folding Top Adjustments) is also on this page.
